tool.name: Aggregate
tool.command:
mkdir pycytominer_output &&
## Since the strata headers are input as integers, they need to be converted in a a comma separated string columns_headers=`head -n1 "$profiles" | cut -d, -f"$strata"` &&
pycytominer aggregate --profiles '$profiles' --output_file './pycytominer_output/output.csv' --output_type 'csv' --strata "\$columns_headers" --operation '$operation'
&& cp './pycytominer_output/output.csv' '$output'

param.name: profiles
param.label: Input cell-profiling table
param.help: Table with features extracted from biological images

param.name: strata
param.label: Aggregation columns
param.help: Select column names to aggregate by (i.e. Metadata_Plate, Metadata_Well)

tool.help:
**What it does**
**Pycytominer aggregate** collapses single-cell rows into one representative profile per well by taking the median (or mean) of each feature across all cells in that well.
Documentation: https://pycytominer.readthedocs.io/en/stable/index.html
